about: Heteronym senses for ForSpeech/PickSenses (B20, CROSS X-016): BookLyre's English cases from EpubToM4B tests/fixtures/spoken_heteronyms.json with this lexicon's stand-ins (my-newt -> mynoot, base -> bayss; led/bough/boughs are real words with the right sound, boughed/boughing are Lexicon() entries), plus street and driving negatives. Divergence: Backseat swaps all-caps words too (tier-2 lines shout in capitals), so 'LEAD PIPE' reads 'Led PIPE'. BookLyre's French cases are left out (English voice only).

cases.expected: He hit him with a led pipe.
